inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There was not a active background check for the primary caregiver and there were no background results for the assistant caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: While reviewing records Asst. Caregiver did not have a CPR/1st Aid certificate available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - Affidavit: While review records for Asst. Caregiver an completed notarized Licensing Affidavit for Applicants for Employment not available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - Affidavit (26 TAC §747.1207(6))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - Orientation: Asst. caregiver did not have a completed orientation listed in folder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - Orientation (26 TAC §747.1207(3))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: In the children s bathroom, a bottle of disinfectant spray was under an unlocked cabinet accessible to children. Note: The director removed a bottle of disinfectant spray.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: I evaluated 4 children's records. I observed the following:    1. No date of admission in 3 of the files.  2. No emergency contact listed in 2 of the children's records.   3. No address documented for emergency contact in one file.  4. The immunization record was up to date in one file.  5. No documentation of vision and hearing screening for a child who turned 4 before Sept. 1st of 2022.

Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: As of 2-18-22, corrections for the following deficiency have not been submitted:    I did not observe information concerning the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity documented in the home's operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation: As of 2-18-22, corrections for the following deficiency have not been submitted:    I did not observe documentation of orientation for members of the household.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction: As of 2-18-22, corrections for the following deficiency have not been submitted:    I did not observe documentation of this required training for the provider.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction (26 TAC §747.1305(d))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - More Than 5 Years Experience: I did not observe documentation of the 3 hours of training in management for the provider for the 2020-2021 training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - More Than 5 Years Experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(2))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation: I did not observe documentation of orientation for members of the household.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired: I observed that the latching mechanism on the gate leading to the front does not work. I also observed that the gate separating the childcare play yard from the home's back yard is missing. I observed hazards in the home's back yard that are accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction: I did not observe documentation of this required training for the provider.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction (26 TAC §747.1305(d))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: I did not observe the most recent CCR inspection report posted at the operation.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months: I did not observe documentation of current certification in SIDS, Shaken Baby Syndrome or Abusive Head Trauma for the provider.
